Body.Content:
SQL Analytics, a solution based on Azure Log Analytics, will help manage and monitor your Azure SQL databases. Get visibility into the health, performance, and usage of your SQL databases using dashboard views, with detailed reporting and alerting built into the solution. Collect and store related Azure SQL metrics, search and query the stored telemetry, then correlate and visualize the results. This will allow you to detect and respond to issues before they impact your users. This is available as part of Insight & Analytics in Microsoft Operations Management Suite.

Learn more about SQL Analytics

Learn more about Operations Management Suite
